'''Palmo Plaza hotel''' was an upscale hotel on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]]. By [[3 BBY]], a [[Gender|male]] [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman]] [[Thela]] worked as a bellhop for the hotel. Later in that same [[Standard year|year]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] stayed at the hotel while under the alias "Varian Skye" for a planned meeting with the [[Ghorman Front]] regarding the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] occupation of the planet. The next year, in [[2 BBY]], Andor returned to the hotel under the alias "Ronni Googe" to [[assassin]]ate [[ISB Supervisor|Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]]. The next [[Standard day|day]], at least the main lobby of Palmo Plaza hotel was destroyed in an explosion due to a [[C-25 fragmentation grenade]] thrown by Thela during the [[Ghorman Massacre]] to fight against the Empire.

==Description==
Palmo Plaza hotel<ref name="Who Are You AD">{{Andor|Who Are You?}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> was an upscale hotel located at [[Palmo Plaza]] within the capital city of [[Palmo]] on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]]. Rooms at the hotel were equipped with a Holo-screen, air flow, and window blinds, all of which could be controlled from a console on the nightstand.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> Some rooms came with views of the circular plaza and the [[Monument to the Fallen]] at its center. The hotel lobby included a small bar where guests could get drinks.<ref name="Messenger">{{Andor|Messenger}}</ref>

==History==
[[Thela]], a [[gender|male]] [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman]] started working as a bellhop at the hotel,<ref name="Thela">{{Databank|thela|Thela}}</ref> by [[3 BBY]],<ref name="GhormanDate">{{AndorDate|205}}</ref> even though the nearby plaza being the site of the [[Thela's father|his father's]] [[death|murder]] during the [[Tarkin Massacre]].<ref name="Thela" /> The hotel asked its staff not to discuss the massacre with guests. During 3 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] checked into the hotel while posing as a [[Coruscanti]] [[fashion designer]] named Varian Skye. Thela showed him to his room and outlined its features to Andor.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> 

During the following year, the [[Galactic Empire]]'s control on Ghorman increased and began requiring the hotel to turn over their guest list each afternoon. In [[2 BBY]], Andor once again checked into the hotel but this time under using the alias Ronni Googe, a [[journalist]] from [[Mid Rim News|Mid-Rim News]]. In reality Andor was there to [[assassin|assassinate]] [[Dedra Meero]], and [[ISB Supervisor]] overseeing the Empire's efforts on Ghorman. Thela, having remembered Andor, warned him that the [[Unidentified hotel clerk 2|other hotel clerk]] that checked him in would send his information to the Empire.<ref name="Messenger" /> Andor was given the same room he used the previous year with overlook the plaza and gave him a good view into the [[Imperial office complex]]. As he checked out his room, he realized that two [[stormtrooper]]s were positioned on the terrace above<ref name="Messenger AD">{{Andor|Messenger}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref>

The following morning as Andor was assembling a [[rifle]] in his room, a [[Bloy's riot squad|squad]] of [[Imperial security trooper]]s began removing the barricades around the plaza to allow Ghorman protestors to assemble. Realizing he would not be able to successfully take a shot from his room, Andor made his way out of the hotel. Before leaving the lobby, he handed his keycard to Thela and wished him well. Soon after, the Empire began a [[Ghorman Massacre|massacre]] of the Ghorman people. Members of a local rebel cell called the [[Ghorman Front]] fought against the attack, resulting in a chaotic shootout near the hotel. During the attack, Thela waved at a group of hunkered guests at the front window of the of hotel to move away from the violence and further into the hotel.  As the battle continued, a number of [[stormtrooper]]s fired from a position near the front of the hotel. Seeing this, Thela activated a [[C-25 fragmentation grenade]] and threw it from his position behind the lobby check-in desk toward the hotel's windows where it exploded killing a number of troopers and destroying the front of the hotel.<ref name="Who Are You">{{Andor|Who Are You?}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The hotel appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's fifth episode, "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]," which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
